title: Transactional Financial Controller
description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

The Transactional Financial Controller owns the full Accounts Payable, Billing function, Credit control, working capital management, and banking operations across the group, while also leading the ongoing automation and optimisation of the finance systems that underpin transactional finance. This is a hybrid role based in London combining hands-on operational leadership of AP, Billing and credit control teams and processes with responsibility for driving system-led improvement, control, and efficiency across the wider finance systems landscape along with the Finance transformation team.This role has line management responsibility for a team based in London and Porto, working under hybrid and remote arrangements

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Transactional Finance (AP, Billing and Credit control) Management

  • Full management of the Accounts Payable and Billing and Credit control functions, including team leadership, prioritisation and quality control.

  • Oversight of all banking and expense transactions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and appropriate controls.

  • Own working capital management, including planning and execution of payment runs.

  • Implement and manage the Purchase Order (PO) system end-to-end, liaising with stakeholders across the business to ensure compliance and efficient processing.

  • Act as the escalation point for AP, Billing and Credit control queries, both internal and external, ensuring timely and professional resolution.

title: Security & Compliance Engineer - Remote Germany
description:
About Linro

Linro is a cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Cloud infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making those changes, not people. Most security tools only catch problems after the fact. Linro works differently. We enforce what's allowed at every stage, from commit to production. We stop bad changes before they ship, and fix problems in real time once they're live.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You will own Linro's security and compliance program end to end, starting from a blank page. Your job is to build that from scratch: figure out where we actually stand, find the gaps, and close them across a multi-cloud environment. Automate what can be automated instead of redoing the same work by hand every quarter.

What you will do

  • Take SOC2, ISO 27001 and 42001 from a blank page to audit-ready. Run the gap analysis, document controls and policies, gather and map evidence, track remediation to done, and get us through audit.

  • Automate compliance instead of just babysitting it: build checks and guardrails so we stay continuously compliant, and help ensure our multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and beyond) is managed as Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform.

  • Own our compliance evidence end to end: keep it current, mapped, and audit-ready across whatever tooling we run.

  • Support security operations: monitoring, alert triage, and documenting findings.

  • Stay close to how the product is actually built. Our compliance checks run on the same engine we sell customers, so you are testing the product, not filling out paperwork off to the side.

What we are looking for

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001: you have run a gap analysis, built and mapped evidence, and taken a program through an actual audit, not just studied the framework. Experience across more than one is a plus.

Redpanda is building the Agentic Data Plane (ADP) — the streaming and data infrastructure the world’s largest enterprises run mission-critical agents on. The enterprises winning right now are building agents that encode their own business logic, their own data, their own institutional knowledge into production-grade infrastructure. That’s digital sovereignty, and Redpanda ADP is the infrastructure layer that makes it real.

Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is the delivery arm. We embed engineers directly with strategic customers and build the agents and integrations that turn ADP into owned outcomes. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the builder: embedded on-site, working inside the customer’s environment, writing the code that ships.

This is not a solutions engineering role. You are not here to demo or advise. You are here to build — agents, integrations, data pipelines, and the infrastructure that runs them — alongside a customer team, in their environment, on their timeline.

You Will:  

  • Build at the customer site. Write production-quality agents, integrations, and data pipelines on Redpanda ADP, inside the customer’s environment and codebase. What you ship has to work after you leave.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Waniwani

Waniwani builds the infrastructure that distributes insurance and banking products through AI assistants. We raised an $8M seed led by Seedcamp and work with large European banks and insurers. Each enterprise deal has to be scoped, architected, and deployed into a regulated environment. This role owns the layer between a signed deal and a live deployment.

The role

  • Customer workshops, discovery, and requirements (35%). Run technical discovery and workshops with each client, and translate their needs into clear, buildable product requirements for our sales, ops, and engineering teams. Flag what we need to build to support a given setup, such as client self-hosting.

  • Procurement, security, and delivery oversight (30%). Use our existing compliance library (SOC 2 program, DPAs, prior questionnaire answers) to complete security questionnaires, handle security committees and data-residency questions, and drive procurement to completion. Oversee the MCP deployment itself, which our freelancer network implements.

Across all three, you build the reusable kit that makes this repeatable: scoping templates, architecture patterns, and a procurement answer library.

Objectives

  • 90 days: own scoping and procurement response for active deals, with the reusable kit used on at least one live deal end to end.

  • 6 months: run the full signed-to-live pipeline, including architecture decisions and procurement ownership, without founders in the critical path.

  • 12 months: a repeatable delivery process with patterns reused across clients, and a case for the first hire under this role.

Requirements

  • You are technically credible: you read code, reason fluently about integrations and the MCP and agent stack, and can scope and oversee a deployment. This is not a hands-on production-coding role; implementation is handled by our freelancer network.

  • You are comfortable leading technical conversations with enterprise clients.

title: Werkstudent Planungsrecht & Research (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Mission

Die Software von syte hilft Entwickler*innen, Planer*innen und Investor*innen dabei, komplexe Entscheidungen rund um Immobilienprojekte zu treffen. Jetzt bauen wir eine KI-Suche, die für jedes Grundstück in Deutschland herausfindet, welches Planungsrecht dort gilt: Bebauungsplan, Flächennutzungsplan, Erhaltungssatzung – alles, was zwischen einer Idee und einem genehmigungsfähigen Projekt steht.

Als Werkstudent Planungsrecht & Research (m/w/d) unterstützt du ab dem 01.09.2026 das Product Team dabei, unseren KI-Agenten zu perfektionieren. Mit deiner Expertise im Planungs- und Baurecht prüfst du reale Grundstücke und entwickelst daraus den fachlichen Maßstab, an dem sich unsere KI messen lassen muss.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Planungsrechtliche Recherche und Einordnung: Du verantwortest die inhaltliche Substanz des Datensatzes. Für reale Grundstücke ermittelst du, welche planungsrechtlichen Dokumente dort tatsächlich greifen: Bebauungspläne, Flächennutzungspläne, Erhaltungs- undGestaltungssatzungen und was in der jeweiligen Kommune sonst noch gilt. Dazu die Einordnung nach §§ 30, 34 oder 35 BauGB.
  • Analyse und Struktur: Du analysierst und strukturierst vorhandene und neue Grundstücksfälle und findest belastbare Bewertungsregeln. Diese Arbeit bildet die Grundlage für ein Bewertungsraster, welches wir gemeinsam aufsetzen.
  • Nachweisführung und Datenqualität: Du schaffst eine Datenbank mit allen neuen Recherchen inkl. Quellen und archivierten Dokumenten, damit Rückfragen schnell nachvollzogen werden können.
  • Evaluation und Rückkopplung ins Produkt: Sobald der Datensatz trägt, wird er zum Messinstrument. Du prüfst KI-Antworten gegen deine Recherchen, ordnest Abweichungen ein und erkennst darin Muster statt Einzelfälle. Was du findest, geht als konkreter Input an das Product Team und zukünftig an das Agentic-Search-Team.


Dein Profil

  • Laufendes Studium: Du studierst in einem fortgeschrittenen (Bachelor oder Master) Semester Rechtswissenschaften (gern mit Schwerpunkt Öffentliches Baurecht), Verwaltungswissenschaften, Stadt- oder Raumplanung, Geographie oder Architektur und hast eine aktuelle Studienbescheinigung.
  • Erfahrung im Baurecht: Im Optimalfall hast du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Baurecht oder Raumplanung gesammelt – etwa durch Projektarbeiten oder Praktika.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!


About the role

Platform work at SoSafe carries outsized leverage. One well-run migration touches a dozen services at once. One adopted shared library saves every team that builds on it from solving the same problem twice. One monitoring signal catches a problem before a customer ever sees it. The work often goes unnoticed when it's going well, but its absence is felt across half of Product Development within a week.

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to embed into one of our platform teams and bring order to that complexity. You'll partner closely with the Product Manager, Engineering Manager, and their Tech Leads to drive the when and how of the roadmap: sequencing the work, surfacing risk early, holding cross-team commitments together, and making sure what ships lands cleanly across every team that depends on it.

This role owns program outcomes, not status reports. You'll think in systems, work in mechanisms, and earn trust by removing friction the team didn't know was costing them time.

Here's how you'll make a difference

  • Own end-to-end delivery for programs that touch a dozen services at once: an architecture migration, a compliance remediation, a legacy system sunset.

  • Partner with Product Management and GTM stakeholders on platform changes with customer-facing impact, keeping rollouts, communications, and external commitments in lockstep with engineering delivery.

  • Drive adoption of shared platform capabilities that other teams are supposed to build on, closing the gap between "we shipped it" and teams actually using it.

  • Manage multi-team migrations where downstream consumers, external commitments, and legacy constraints all need to land in the right order. A missed dependency here costs months, not days.

  • Run the mechanics that keep a dozen concurrent programs honest: dependency maps, risk logs, decision records, and the recurring check-ins nobody wants to run but everybody needs.

  • Bring rigor to how delivery health gets measured, incident counts, adoption rates, time-to-land, and use it to drive change instead of producing another report.

Gismart is a value-driven mobile app developer with a strong presence in the Health & Wellness, Utilities, and Music app markets. We have recently reached an important milestone of 1B+ downloads worldwide, moving closer to our mission of supporting people on their self-improvement journeys.

Headquartered in London, Gismart is a global company with a team of 400+ people across Europe and beyond. We bring together professionals from entertainment, music, and tech backgrounds, combining creativity, product thinking, and strong execution to build apps used by millions of people worldwide.

Our mission is to become a stepping stone on our customers’ journeys of self-improvement.

Our values

  • Respect and support others

  • Initiate and own

If you are passionate about mobile products and want to work on apps with real scale, Gismart is the right place to grow, take ownership, and make an impact.

At Radiotech, we believe music should be accessible to everyone — not only to those who grew up taking lessons.

We are a product team inside the Gismart ecosystem, focused on building and growing music apps across iOS and Android. Our goal is to make music feel more approachable, engaging, and human for beginners, hobbyists, and people who want to bring more music into their daily lives.

title: Implementation Delivery Manager
description:
About us

SFG20 is the industry standard for building maintenance. Providing services and pioneering technologies that empower people to create and sustain safer buildings.

Our mission is to make buildings better using our standard, software and expertise. Our vision is to become the leading authority for built environment maintenance that protects and enhances quality of life.

 

About the role

As an Implementation Delivery Manager, you play a critical role in ensuring customers successfully adopt the SFG20 platform, enabling them to realise value quickly and confidently.

By combining project management expertise with hands-on implementation delivery, you will guide customers from project initiation through to go-live. You will deliver a high-quality onboarding experience, manage implementation projects of varying complexity, and coordinate internal resources to ensure implementations are delivered efficiently, on time, and to a consistently high standard. Your work directly contributes to customer satisfaction, adoption, retention, and long-term success.

 

Key Responsibilities

Customer Implementation & Delivery

  • Lead customers through the implementation journey from project kick-off to successful go-live.

  • Configure customer data within the SFG20 platform using internal systems and implementation tools.

  • Prepare, cleanse, manipulate and validate customer data using Microsoft Excel and other implementation tools.

  • Deliver implementation activities in line with agreed project plans, timelines and quality standards.

  • Conduct customer workshops, implementation meetings and progress updates throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Support customers with onboarding activities, system adoption and transition to Business as Usual.

  • Ensure implementation documentation is completed and maintained accurately.

Project Management

  • Manage multiple customer implementation projects simultaneously, ensuring delivery to agreed scope, timescales and budget where applicable.

title: Brand Designer, AI & Ops
description:
TL;DR - We're looking for a world-class brand designer who treats generative AI and custom tooling as a primary production method for brand work. You'll direct AI output at volume, both across Lovable’s brand and creative and Lovable’s output itself. You’ll be working closely with a Brand Engineer to ensure whatever workflow you wish for can scale. This is a new role with no precedent - you’ll be defining a lot of it as you go.

Why Lovable?

Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products - fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Lovable-built applications and websites are visited hundreds of millions of times a month, and our enterprise footprint is compounding fast. And we're just getting started.

We're a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

What we're looking for

  • Strong design taste - you can tell good from generic, and you can articulate why

  • Real fluency with AI generation tools (image, video, whatever's next) as a craft, not a party trick - you already have opinions about which models and workflows produce better output and why

  • Experience creating scalable brand systems, templates, tools, and guidelines that enable teams to execute independently - except here the "team" increasingly includes the AI pipeline itself

  • A portfolio of shipped brand assets - campaign visuals, social graphics, presentation decks, event materials, marketing collateral - plus evidence of AI-native production, not just AI-assisted

  • Comfortable with ambiguity - this function doesn't have a template at Lovable or anywhere else yet

  • Technical range - prompt engineering counts, scripting, automation and building custom tools is even better. We're not asking you to be an engineer, but the more range you have the faster the seam between you and the Brand Engineer disappears.

What you'll do

In one sentence: Shape how the world sees and experiences Lovable, using AI as the primary means of production.

📍 London or Remote

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $100M+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Money moves through Fanvue in three directions every day: fans paying in, acquirers settling to our banks, and creators being paid out what they have earned. At our scale, across a multi-acquirer stack and multiple currencies, proving that all of it happened correctly is a discipline in its own right. That is what this role owns.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring a Payments & Treasury Analyst to own continuous reconciliation of money movement across the platform, reporting directly to our VP Finance with a dotted line into Operations.

This is a Finance controls role. Operations runs the payment rails. You prove the money moved, every day, independently. The distinction matters and it is the whole point of the job.

Today reconciliation happens periodically. Your job is to make it constant and owned. We are building the ledger and matching tooling in parallel, so the mechanical matching will be automated. What automation cannot do is own the exceptions daily and apply payments judgement: reading an acquirer statement and spotting a fee that does not match the agreement, or knowing whether a settlement gap is a weekend cycle or a genuine break. That judgement is why this is a specialist hire rather than generalist finance headcount.

You will be doing live reconciliation work from week one. There is no synthetic onboarding period.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Own the daily acquirer to bank reconciliation across our full acquirer estate

  • Stand up and run independent daily monitoring of creator payouts against earnings owed, so no payout moves without reconciliation behind it

  • Publish a weekly reconciled percentage per leg to Finance, and keep an exceptions queue that gets worked rather than just logged

  • Validate acquirer fees against every merchant services agreement and recover variances

  • Map FX exposure across settlement vendors and optimise cash held

title: Senior Spacecraft Systems Engineer – Avionics & Electrical Systems (m/f/d)
description:
Deine Mission

As part of our Avionics & Software team in Munich, you will help define and mature the avionics and electrical systems of our spacecraft platforms. You will translate mission and spacecraft-level needs into clear requirements, interfaces and equipment decisions. Working closely with our Systems Architects and specialist teams in electronics, embedded software and controls, you will ensure that avionics equipment and subsystems form a coherent and verifiable overall system. This is a systems engineering role with a strong technical focus. You are not expected to be the implementation expert for every avionics domain.

Your role will include

  • Define, manage and maintain spacecraft avionics and electrical system requirements.
  • Coordinate interfaces between spacecraft equipment, electronics, embedded software, control systems and higher-level spacecraft functions.
  • Support avionics architecture development together with Systems Architects and technical specialists.
  • Perform and document equipment and make-or-buy trade studies, for example for OBCs, PCDUs, solar arrays, sensors, communication equipment and remote I/O.
  • Translate selected equipment into clear electrical, data and software interface requirements.
  • Develop and maintain interface control documents, architecture descriptions and verification concepts.
  • Coordinate technical topics with suppliers and assess compliance, development status, risks and open points.
  • Support proposal activities through requirements analysis, preliminary architectures, supplier inputs, effort estimates and technical risk assessments.
  • Support subsystem and spacecraft-level integration, verification and troubleshooting.
  • Contribute to MBSE models and continuously improve our systems engineering processes.


Dein Profil

  • Several years of experience in spacecraft avionics, electrical systems or a comparable safety-critical engineering environment.
  • Experience in requirements engineering, interface definition and technical trade studies.
  • Broad understanding of spacecraft avionics and electrical equipment, without the expectation of being a specialist in every domain.
  • Ability to work effectively with electronics, software, controls and systems engineering teams.
  • Experience working with suppliers and evaluating technical proposals or equipment.
  • Familiarity with verification planning, integration testing and relevant systems engineering standards such as ECSS.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with a structured and accountable way of working.
  • Motivation to develop systems for space logistics and orbital servicing.

Nice to have
  • Experience with spacecraft power systems, data handling, sensors or communication equipment.
  • Experience with MBSE too

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

title: Customer Service & Accounting Werkstudent (m/w/d)
description:
Über BETTER CAKEZ:

BETTER CAKEZ wurde 2024 von Isabelle Forster gegründet – aus ihrer großen Liebe zu Kuchen und einer ganz persönlichen Herausforderung heraus.

Aufgrund einer Gluten- und Laktoseunverträglichkeit war Isabelle stark in ihrer Ernährung eingeschränkt und konnte vor allem eines nicht mehr essen: ihren heißgeliebten Bäckerkuchen. Also stellte sie sich zwei Jahre lang selbst in die Küche und entwickelte Kuchen, die vor allem eines sein sollten: sündhaft lecker – aber gleichzeitig gesünder und leicht verträglich.

Das Ergebnis begeisterte nicht nur sie selbst, sondern auch ihr gesamtes Umfeld. So sehr, dass Isabelle überzeugt wurde, ihr zweites Staatsexamen in Jura nicht mehr anzutreten und stattdessen ihre gesünderen Snack-Kuchen to go auch anderen zugänglich zu machen.

Und das Wichtigste hätten wir fast vergessen: Sie sind sündhaft lecker.

title: Football Tracking Systems Operator (RoC)
description:
Location: Basingstoke, Hampshire. This is an in-office role, and as such, will require you to live within a reasonable commute.

Contract: Casual hourly contract

Working Hours: Shifts typically 10 - 12 hours

Hourly Rate: £13.00 - £18.20 Per Hour (exact rate will vary depending on role)

Start Date: July/August 2026

Why Hawk-Eye & Why This Role?:

We are looking for candidates to play a key part in delivering Goal Line Technology (GLT) at our centre in Basingstoke; however, there is scope for successful candidates to be offered further opportunities in delivering Electronic Performance and Tracking Systems (EPTS) and Semi-Automatic Offside (SAO) in elite football competitions. Having successfully deployed this system across UEFA competitions, we are now expanding our remote operations to include the Premier League and Championship.


Based in the Remote Operations Centre (ROC) at Hawk-Eye’s Head Office in Basingstoke, you'll play a crucial role in operating cutting-edge technology, liaising with Hawk-Eye colleagues on the ground across the UK, and a range of external stakeholders, contributing to the excitement of live sports events.

While this is a casual contract, we are seeking candidates with full availability across the week. This role is designed for those looking to commit to significant hours, particularly during peak periods of the football calendar.

What Does A Typical Day Look Like?

For a typical 3pm kick off you can expect our call time to be 5 to 6 hours prior to the start of the match. Throughout the day you will be faced with several hard deadlines in which you will have to meet in order for the service to run effectively and efficiently.

Initially, you will spend the first part of your day testing communications, calibrating, and optimising the technology. This ensures GLT is fully operational two hours prior to kick-off, allowing match officials to test its integrity.

Warm up is our final opportunity to ensure the system is fully functional before we enter the live match. During the live match you will be monitoring the data, fine tuning the calibration and constantly preparing to produce a virtual replay for broadcasters should a goal line incident occur and activate our GLT system.

title: Strategic Account Manager - London
description:
Meet Siena

Siena is the Agent of Record for consumer brands. One agent that owns the entire customer journey, running on a shared intelligence layer no point tool can replicate.

Consumer brands run ten or more disconnected tools to manage their customers. We collapse that stack into a single agent. It started with support, the hardest surface a brand has, and it expands from there: Shopping Agent, Social Agent, Siena working alongside a brand's own operators. One agent across every surface, with shared memory, shared context, and shared tools.

Hundreds of brands already run real customer volume on Siena in production. This is built, working, and growing, and we are racing to build what comes next.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to own real problems rather than close tickets, keep reading.

The Role

You own the commercial relationship for Siena's highest-value brands: renewals, expansion, executive trust, and knowing your accounts better than anyone. A deployment strategist owns product outcomes for the same accounts — together you're the Siena pod.

You hold your accounts to specific, measurable commercial outcomes: net dollar retention, expansion, and the strength of the executive relationship. You own our Growth and Strategic segment accounts - not the full customer book - and work at the intersection of customer, sales, and your deployment strategist. You'll lead commercial reviews, executive account mapping, and account planning, and run in-person workshops, account visits, and QBRs with your accounts. Expect moderate travel.

What Success Looks Like

You are accountable for:

  • Net dollar retention (NDR) of your book

  • Expansion quota attainment

  • Executive relationship health across your accounts

What You'll Do

Own the Commercial Relationship End to End

  • Own a portfolio of Growth and Strategic accounts from post-onboarding through long-term growth

We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to saving space, protecting our planet and turning connectivity into actionable intelligence.

title: Senior Retention & CRM Manager (m/w/d) - E-Mail-Marketing (Klaviyo), WhatsApp & Treueprogramm · Vollzeit · Start: ab sofort · Office oder Hybrid, Remote möglich
description:
Über uns
Naschen klingt für viele nach schlechtem Gewissen. Bei uns nicht. NaschNatur macht Schokolade, Riegel und Aufstriche, die ausschließlich mit Datteln gesüßt sind statt mit Industriezucker oder anderen Süßungsmitteln – bio, vegan, ohne Zusatzstoffe, mit Zutaten, die man aussprechen kann - und machen daraus Süßes, dass einfach richtig gut schmeckt.

Ob das funktioniert, sagen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden besser als jede Anzeige: 4,94 von 5 Sternen bei über 3.500 Bewertungen. Dazu kommen Nachrichten, für die man sich Zeit nehmen muss — seitenlang, und erstaunlich oft steht darin das Wort „lebensverändernd". Menschen, die ihren Zuckerkonsum umgestellt haben und uns erzählen, was sich dadurch für sie verändert hat.

Genau da setzt diese Rolle an. Wer sich für weniger Zucker entscheidet, entscheidet sich nicht einmal — sondern jeden Tag neu. Wir wollen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden auf diesem Weg begleiten: mit E-Mails und Nachrichten, die zum richtigen Zeitpunkt kommen, die weiterhelfen statt nur zu verkaufen, und die aus einer guten Entscheidung eine Gewohnheit machen. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Deine Mission
Du machst aus Erstkäufern Stammkunden. Du verantwortest unser CRM — Flows, Kampagnen, Segmentierung — baust WhatsApp als neuen Kanal von Grund auf auf und entwickelst unser Treue- und Referral-Programm. Deine Nordstern-Metrik: die Wiederkaufrate.

Ausgangslage
Es gibt bei NaschNatur bisher kein CRM-Team, keine Agentur und keine gewachsene Struktur. Klaviyo läuft, erste Flows stehen — der Rest ist offen. Du bist die erste Person, die diesen Bereich verantwortet und ihn von hier aus aufbaut.
Das heißt in den ersten Monaten: Du machst fast alles selbst. Flows bauen, Segmente anlegen, Kampagnen einplanen, WhatsApp-Setup aufsetzen, Reportings ziehen, Tools evaluieren. Es gibt niemanden, an den du Umsetzung abgeben kannst. Hands-on ist in dieser Rolle keine Floskel, sondern die Arbeitsbeschreibung — die Strategie entsteht beim Bauen, nicht davor.

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest unser E-Mail-Marketing in Klaviyo end-to-end: Flows (Welcome, Post-Purchase, Win-Back), Kampagnen, Segmentierung, A/B-Tests, Deliverability
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Gründerin Andi zusammen: Sie schreibt die Texte für unsere Mails, du machst daraus Kampagnen und Flows, die zur richtigen Zeit bei den richtigen Menschen landen — inklusive Kalender, Briefings und Freigabeprozess
  • Du baust unseren WhatsApp-Kanal auf: Opt-in-Strecken, Automationen, Kanalstrategie — und verzahnst ihn sauber mit der E-Mail statt ihn danebenzustellen
  • Du entwickelst und betreibst unser Treueprogramm und unser Referral-Programm
  • Du baust unsere Lifecycle-Logik über alle Kanäle: Wer bekommt wann welche Botschaft — und wer bewusst keine
  • Du arbeitest datenbasiert: Kohorten, Wiederkaufraten, Lifecycle-Analysen — und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab<

title: Engineering Supervisor /  Safety Technology Implementation Lead
description:
Are you an experienced railway professional with knowledge and experience of roles like COSS, ES and PICOP?

You already understand the track and the people who work on it. We're looking for people like you to help put new safety technology into the hands of the workforce - and to be part of a big change in how track workers are kept safe.

At Tended, we create first-of-a-kind safety systems that transform rail worker safety. Our geofencing solution has been named one of TIME's Best Inventions and has made the Digital Leaders 100 list for Geospatial Initiative of the Year. It's already out there on the track, helping to keep people away from the running line and improving on site efficiency.

Network Rail is committed to geofencing for the long term, and the rollout across the Sussex region is already underway. We're looking for an Implementation Lead to help us grow our capability on the ground.

Tasks

As an Implementation Lead, you're the bridge between Tended and our clients, guiding their teams through helping their teams get comfortable using our kit out on-site.

You'll lead key client deployments on the ground, working closely with Tended's project managers to deliver an excellent service. Success in this role depends on building strong, trusting relationships quickly - so first-class communication and interpersonal skills are essential.

Our technology is used by track workers with a wide range of technical confidence. You'll develop a deep understanding of our products so you can coach users through their day-to-day challenges and until they’re confident using it on their own. Being on-site also puts you in a unique position to see how our products are really used - spotting ideas for how we can make it better and feeding improvements back to the team.

You'll need strong knowledge of the rail environment and the roles within it, and you'll either hold a Personal Track Safety (PTS) qualification or meet the requirements to obtain one. Above all, we're looking for someone proactive and approachable - person fit matters to us.**

Travel and working pattern

This is a field-based role centred on regular client site visits across the Sussex region. You'll spend at least 3 days a week in the depot and on site, with the remaining time working remotely or in person with your line manager.

Because our users work shifts, this role covers both nightshifts and dayshifts, and includes weekend and bank holiday working - flexibility to meet the needs of the business and our clients is essential.

In return, we have excellent policies covering travel, accommodation and subsistence expenses, as well as fatigue management and time off in lieu.

A full driving licence is required.

title: Technical Program Manager - EU / UK
description:
As a Technical Program Manager at Marqeta, you will be responsible for leading technical workstreams or initiatives, coordinating work across engineering teams to deliver complex projects on time and within scope. The Product Operations and Technical Program Management team operates as an integral component of the Strategy and Operations organisation within the Product organisation.

We specialise in facilitating and orchestrating Product and Engineering teams and strategic initiatives that encompass our platform, product portfolio, and new innovations for our customers. Our team functions as the essential connective tissue between engineering, product, TechAI, go-to-market, and customer-facing teams, ensuring seamless collaboration and aligned execution across these critical organisational functions.

This role can be performed remotely within the UK or from our London, Holborn office. We’d love for you to join us!

The Impact You’ll Have

  • Drive technical projects from concept to completion, managing scope, schedule, and resources

  • Identify dependencies, risks, and issues; develop mitigation strategies

  • Facilitate communication between engineering, product, design, and business teams

  • Lead technical planning, estimation, and prioritization sessions

  • Document technical decisions and ensure alignment across stakeholders

  • Provide regular status updates to leadership and remove obstacles for engineering teams

  • Balance technical tradeoffs with business requirements and timelines

  Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field

  • 3+ years of technical program/project management experience

  • Strong understanding of relevant technologies, software development methodologies and processes (S-SDLC)

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and development practices

  • Ability to understand complex technical systems and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences

Nice-to-Haves

Aurora is on a mission to create a future of solar for all. This position is hybrid from Munich, Germany.

description:
Wir bei nutri+ glauben an eine Welt, in der Tiere respektiert werden und niemand zurückgelassen wird. Deshalb setzen wir uns nicht nur für hochwertige vegane Produkte ein, sondern unterstützen aktiv den Tier- und Umweltschutz. Mit unseren Inhalten möchten wir Wissen vermitteln, Menschen für eine pflanzliche Ernährung begeistern und zeigen, wie einfach und lecker vegan sein kann. Dafür suchen wir Dich als Werkstudent Content & Redaktion (m/w/d) mit Freude am Schreiben, an Ernährung und daran, auch selbst vor der Kamera zu stehen.

Deine Mission

Als Werkstudent Content & Redaktion (m/w/d) unterstützt Du uns dabei, hochwertige und relevante Inhalte rund um vegane Ernährung, Gesundheit und unsere Produkte zu entwickeln. Du recherchierst spannende Themen, verfasst Blogartikel und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team neue Rezepte.

Einige unserer Rezepte und Inhalte bringen wir außerdem auf YouTube – und hier kommst Du auch vor der Kamera ins Spiel. Du bereitest ausgewählte Inhalte für unsere Videos auf, präsentierst Rezepte und erklärst Ernährungsthemen verständlich, sympathisch und authentisch.

Aufgaben

  • Du recherchierst und verfasst Blogartikel rund um vegane Ernährung, Gesundheit, Nährstoffe und weitere relevante Themen
  • Du entwickelst neue vegane Rezepte und bereitest diese redaktionell für unseren Blog und unseren YouTube-Kanal auf und stehst dort auch selbst vor der Kamera
  • Du überarbeitest und aktualisierst bestehende Artikel und Inhalte und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team Ideen für neue Artikel
  • Du recherchierst wissenschaftliche Quellen und bereitest komplexe Ernährungsthemen verständlich und zielgruppengerecht auf
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team Ideen für neue Videoformate
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Marketing-, Content- und Design-Team zusammen
  • Du achtest darauf, dass unsere Inhalte fachlich fundiert sind und gleichzeitig zu nutri+ und unserer Zielgruppe passen

Qualifikation

  • Du studierst Ernährungswissenschaften, Marketing oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang - noch mind. 2 Semester
  • Du interessierst Dich für vegane Ernährung, Gesundheit und Lebensmittel und hast Lust, Dich intensiv mit diesen Themen auseinanderzusetzen

  • Du hast Freude am Schreiben und kannst Inhalte verständlich, ansprechend und zielgruppengerecht formulieren
  • Du hast Spaß daran, Rezepte auszuprobieren und neue Ideen zu entwickeln

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Hilo by Aktiia 

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18 million deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, our vision is a world where no lives are lost or damaged from the effects of high blood pressure. Our mission is to make this a reality by developing tech to help people control their blood pressure. 

We are a venture-backed scale-up, having raised over $96M from investors in Europe and the United States. Our technology — rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM) — is the world's only medically accurate, continuous blood pressure monitor that is cuffless in daily life in the consumer space. Validated through extensive clinical trials and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, our solution is now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US — a major step in bringing Hilo's technology to the millions of Americans living with high blood pressure. 

We are a hybrid/remote-first company, headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. 


Role Overview 

We're looking for a Data Scientist who can turn large, complex real-world and clinical datasets into robust statistical analyses, models, and actionable insights. You will work on clinical, scientific, product, and business questions and translate data into findings that support scientific publications and informed decision-making across the company. 

This is a hands-on role with a high degree of autonomy, where you will independently take analytical questions from data preparation through statistical analysis and interpretation, while collaborating closely with clinical, scientific, product, and engineering teams. 

Requirements

What You Will Own 

  • Mine and analyse large-scale real-world data from Aktiia's databases to identify patterns, trends, and relationships related to clinical outcomes, product performance, accuracy, and usage 
  • Design, perform, and interpret statistical analyses of clinical study data, working with the clinical team on study endpoints, protocols, and appropriate analytical approaches
  • Produce analytical results into clear scientific insights, publication-ready figures, and statistical summaries that support conference presentations, posters, and peer-reviewed publications
  • Apply statistical and analytical methods to user and product data to answer questions around engagement, retention, conversion, feature usage, and segmentation 
  • Design, run, and interpret experiments and statistical tests to evaluate product or feature changes and quantify their impact

description:

You will work asynchronously on a dedicated platform, within your own specialty and day-to-day scope of practice.

  • Scenario Design: Design realistic clinical scenarios and instructions that mirror the work you carry out day-to-day in your specialty.

Legal Status

🙏 Win win Szenario: Höhere Lebensqualität & Flexibilität für Bewohner:innen UND Entlastung für E Commerce und Paketdienstleister.

Sorge dafür, dass neue Standorte reibungslos umgesetzt werden und bestehende Infrastruktur technisch stabil bleibt.
🔍 Als Technischer Projektkoordinator für die Region München

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest die technische Umsetzung und Betreuung der Smart Locker Infrastruktur in deiner Region.
🔍 Das heißt konkret:

  • Perspektivisch erfolgt die Koordination der Errichtung neuer Standorte in enger Zusammenarbeit mit externen Gewerken.

  • Organisationsgeschick zur Überwachung von Projektfortschritten

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About Nucs AI

Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning—building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.

Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity—moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves.

The Opportunity

Nucs AI is looking for a Senior Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of complex technology and specialized end-users. You will own critical parts of our product roadmap, translating deep clinical and technical requirements into clear product direction, then driving execution across data, engineering, regulatory, and commercial areas. This is not a role where you manage a feature backlog in isolation; you will be expected to build conviction around what we should build, why, and in what order, and to defend that thinking rigorously.

What You’ll Do

Product Development Support

  • Own the roadmap for one or more product lines (e.g., DeepPSMA, SelectPSMA, TrackPSMA), balancing clinical impact, technical feasibility, and business value.

  • Engage directly with clinicians, nuclear medicine physicians, and oncologists to deeply understand their workflows, pain points, and decision-making processes.

  • Translate ambiguous, technically complex problems into well-structured product requirements and clear success criteria.

  • Develop and articulate a clear product narrative: why this feature matters, who it serves, and how it connects to the broader platform vision.

title: IT System Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Gestalte komplexe IT-Systemlandschaften im Gesundheitswesen

Du möchtest nicht nur Tickets bearbeiten, sondern komplexe IT-Systeme verstehen, optimieren und gemeinsam mit Kunden weiterentwickeln? Dich reizt eine Rolle, in der Systemintegration, Infrastruktur, Datenbanken, Netzwerke und Kundenkommunikation zusammenkommen? Dann erwartet Dich hier eine abwechslungsreiche Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung.

Für unseren Partner, ein etabliertes Softwareunternehmen mit Fokus auf die Digitalisierung von Gesundheitseinrichtungen, suchen wir einen IT System Engineer (m/w/d).

Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team sorgst Du dafür, dass moderne Enterprise-Content-Management-Lösungen (ECM) und Dokumentenmanagementsysteme (DMS) bei Kunden zuverlässig implementiert, betrieben und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden.

Dich erwartet eine komplexe Systemlandschaft mit zahlreichen technischen Schnittstellen und individuellen Kundenanpassungen. Statt standardisierter Routineaufgaben arbeitest Du an maßgeschneiderten Lösungen und bist technischer Ansprechpartner für Kunden – von der Implementierung über Systemerweiterungen bis hin zur Fehleranalyse und Optimierung.

Aufgaben

  • Installation, Konfiguration und Inbetriebnahme moderner Enterprise Content Management (ECM)- und Dokumentenmanagement-Systeme (DMS)
  • Betreuung komplexer Windows-Systemlandschaften sowie Durchführung von Software-Updates und Releasewechseln
  • Einrichtung, Konfiguration und Optimierung technischer Schnittstellen sowie Durchführung von Datenmigrationen
  • Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen per Remote-Zugriff im 2nd-Level-Support
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem 1st-Level-Support auf Kundenseite zur nachhaltigen Lösungsfindung
  • Direkter Austausch mit Kunden zur Analyse technischer Anforderungen und Entwicklung individueller Lösungen
  • Unterstützung der IT-Consultants und Projektteams bei technischen Fragestellungen
  • Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen sowie Wissensdatenbanken
  • Mitarbeit in einem 19-köpfigen Team, aufgeteilt auf drei spezialisierte Fachbereiche
  • Aktive Mitgestaltung und kontinuierliche Optimierung bestehender IT-Infrastrukturen und Systemlandschaften

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration bzw. eine vergleichbare IT-Qualifikation
  • Berufserfahrung als IT System Engineer, Systemadministrator, IT Consultant, IT Support Engineer, Technical Consultant oder IT Systemadministrator
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Microsoft Windows Server-Umfeld
  • Erfahrung in der Administration komplexer IT-Infrastrukturen
  • Gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Netzwerktechnik (TCP/IP, DNS, Active Directory, Netzwerkkommunikation oder vergleichbare Technologien)
  • Erfahrung mit SQL sowie grundlegendes Datenbank

title: Referent:in Kommunikation & Verbandsorganisation
description:
Teilzeit | ca. 20–25 Stunden/Woche | Großraum Frankfurt | flexibel & überwiegend remote

Sie möchten Kommunikation mitgestalten, eigene Ideen einbringen und mit Ihrer Arbeit etwas bewegen?

Der Deutsche Schädlingsbekämpfer-Verband e. V. (DSV) stellt seine Geschäftsstelle neu auf. Dafür suchen wir zur Direkteinstellung eine kommunikativ starke Persönlichkeit, die gerne schreibt, strukturiert arbeitet und Freude daran hat, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Als Referent:in Kommunikation & Verbandsorganisation (m/w/d) gestalten Sie die Kommunikation mit Mitgliedern, Öffentlichkeit und weiteren Stakeholdern und arbeiten eng mit dem ehrenamtlichen Vorstand zusammen. Dabei erwartet Sie keine Rolle mit starren, bereits vollständig definierten Abläufen: Sie haben die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Kommunikationswege weiterzuentwickeln und den Aufbau einer modernen, digital arbeitenden Geschäftsstelle aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Sie gestalten den DSV-Newsletter – von der Themenplanung und Redaktion über Layout und Versand bis zur Auswertung.

description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

Berlitz's brand hasn't had a dedicated design owner. You'll partner closely with Marketing on brand strategy, but you'll own how that strategy actually looks and feels everywhere it shows up. You'll also work alongside the product design team to make sure brand and product pull in the same direction, extending our shared design system rather than working apart from it.

What you'll be doing

  • Own brand guidelines and visual identity end to end: typography, color, imagery, and motion, documented clearly enough that a global, multi-country organization can actually follow them.

title: Data Scientist with focus Bioinformatics / Diagnostics (f/m/d - part/full-time)
description:
Your responsibilities will include

  • Analysis of multiomics data (e.g., NGS, transcriptomics, metabolomics) in oncology / inflammation
  • Support non-clinical / clinical development in all phases, analysis plan (e.g. SAP), reporting
  • Implementation and reporting of exploratory biomarker analyses
  • Serving clients with ad-hoc data analysis requests and statistical consulting
  • Following quality and documentation standards in a GxP environment
  • Supporting the bioinformatics/statistics team, as well as independent work in diverse and exciting projects


Your profile

  • Master’s degree / PhD in bioinformatics, computer science, or equivalent education 
  • Experience in analysing multiomics and biomarker data (e.g., NGS data including transcriptomics); gene set analysis and clustering is a plus
  • Experience in setting up / executing bioinformatics pipelines using e.g. Nextflow, containerisation 
  • Solid knowledge and understanding of statistical concepts e.g. hypothesis testing, survival analysis, linear models, as well as experience in the application of advanced statistics visualizing, exploring and modeling multivariate data sets
  • Very good programming skills in R / Bioconductor; Shell-scripting and Git is a plus
  • Good overview of state-of-the-art bioinformatics tools and proven record of the ability to collect, combine and analyse complex types of data 
  • Fast comprehension, analytical thinking, teamwork and a high degree of initiative, willingness to learn
  • Creativity and joy in solving complex analytical questions and proactive working style
  • Very good English skills, German is an advantage



What we offer you

We value communication, flat hierarchies, open corporate culture, and a harmonious work environment. We offer comprehensive individual development opportunities, continuous trainings, and flexible working hours. A modern and bright office with a subsidised canteen, as well as the opportunity to work 2 days per week from home are part of our everyday working life. Full remote work from anywhere in Germany for those who do not live in Munich can be discussed. You will join an interdisciplinary team allowing you to discuss with and learn from peers with many different backgrounds.

  • Features zur Optimierung des Praxisalltags entwickeln: Deine Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, neue Features zu konzipieren und umzusetzen, die den Arbeitsalltag in Arztpraxen erleichtern.

title: OEM Applications Engineer - EMEA
description:
Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Evident employs around 4,500 people at a total of 57 locations worldwide. Evident Europe, headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, employs approximately 770 people in 16 countries. The product portfolio includes a wide range of microscope systems used in clinical diagnostics, medical and basic research, as well as in various industrial areas.

At Evident, we deliver optical technology that pushes the limits of scientific discovery. Through advanced microscopy solutions, we help researchers and innovators illuminate the unseen.

Tasks

We’re looking for an OEM Applications Engineer, who plays a critical role in securing long-term design wins by engaging with OEM customers early in the development of next-generation instruments. This role combines deep technical expertise in optical systems with a strong consultative approach to influence system architecture decisions and position optical solutions as enabling technologies within customer platforms.

Working closely with OEM Sales, Product Management, and R&D, the Applications Engineer acts as a trusted technical advisor to customer engineering teams, helping define system requirements, evaluate optical architectures, and optimize instrument performance.

The role focuses on early design-cycle engagement, platform influence, and long-term OEM partnerships, ensuring that optical solutions become an integral part of customer instruments across life science and industrial markets.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Early Design-Cycle Engagement

• Engage with customer R&D teams during concept and architecture phases of instrument development.
• Influence optical system design to ensure optimal integration of optical solutions.
• Identify opportunities where optical performance can enable new instrument capabilities.

Design-Win Development

• Support OEM sales teams in securing strategic design wins within key accounts.
• Develop technical solution strategies tailored to customer system architectures.
• Provide technical leadership during design reviews and feasibility discussions.

System Architecture Consulting

• Work with customer engineering teams to define optimal optical configurations, including objectives, illumination systems, and imaging pathways.
• Evaluate trade-offs in optical performance, system cost, manufacturability, and integration complexity.
• Support prototype development and system validation.

Strategic Customer Partnerships

• Build trusted relationships with customer R&D leaders and system architects.
• Act as a long-term technical partner throughout the lifecycle of customer platforms.
• Provide insights into emerging technology trends and application needs.

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first ecommerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

About the Role

As an Engineering Manager on the Agentic Integrations team, you’ll lead engineers building and scaling integrations for Constructor’s agentic products across our customer base. This team sits within the ML Journey chapter and operates at the intersection of customer needs, applied ML, product engineering, and production integration work.

Your team will work directly with customers and internal teams to bring agentic capabilities into real-world retail workflows, helping customers adopt, configure, extend, and scale these products in their environments. The work spans two fronts: delivering high-quality customer integrations for agentic products, and turning repeated implementation patterns into reusable tooling, frameworks, documentation, and platform capabilities that make future integrations faster and more reliable.

You’ll be responsible for setting the technical and operational direction for the team: how we engage customers, how we make integration work scalable, how we maintain quality across a growing number of deployments, and how we turn customer-specific learnings into product and platform improvements. Success in this role requires strong engineering leadership, customer empathy, excellent prioritization, and the ability to work effectively across Product, ML, Customer Success, Solutions, and core Engineering teams.

Challenges you will tackle

  • Scaling agentic integrations: Be a part of building a new team that can take agentic capabilities from promising product functionality to reliable, production-grade customer deployments across many different customer environments.

  • Balancing customer delivery and scalable foundations: Allocate the team’s capacity across hands-on customer integration work and longer-term investments in reusable tooling, templates, documentation, automation, and platform improvements.

  • Cross-functional collaboration and prioritization: Work closely with Product, ML, Customer Success, Solutions, and other Engineering teams to prioritize customer needs, unblock adoption, and ensure integration learnings feed back into the product roadmap.

  • Technical direction and quality: Set a high bar for architecture, testing, observability, reliability, and maintainability in customer-facing integrations, especially where agentic systems interact with customer data, workflows, and business-critical experiences.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.


The Role

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to support hiring across multiple functions and regions as BJAK continues to scale globally.

This is a hands-on recruitment role for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple hiring priorities, and partnering closely with stakeholders to deliver hiring outcomes. You will have exposure to a wide range of functions including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, and other business-critical teams.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for assigned roles across multiple functions and locations.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, candidate profiles, and business priorities.

  • Source, screen, assess, and engage candidates through various channels including LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, job boards, and direct outreach.

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for both active and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping and market research to support hiring strategies.

  • Coordinate and manage interview processes while ensuring a positive candidate experience.

  • Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment activities within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

  • Provide regular hiring updates and pipeline insights to hiring managers and stakeholders.

  • Support recruitment process improvements, hiring initiatives, and employer branding activities where required.

About Precoro

Precoro is an agentic procurement, AP and spend management platform.

Most mid-market finance teams find out what they spent after they spent it. Someone chases purchase orders over email, someone keys invoices into the ledger, and the Finance Director learns what a site committed several weeks after it committed it. The software built to fix that was designed for the Fortune 500: six-figure licences, rollouts measured in quarters, a consulting partner attached to the contract. Everyone below that line got left with spreadsheets.

We built Precoro for the companies underneath it. A £60m business with four sites gets the control a global one has, live in about three weeks, on the finance system it already runs: Sage, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics or Xero. Spend gets approved against budget before the money moves. Invoices reconcile against orders and receipts on their own. The CFO sees committed spend the day it is committed rather than at month end.

The AI work is the part we are most excited about, and it is where this category is heading. Agents raise and chase POs, route approvals to the right budget holder, read invoices and match them to orders and goods received. Procurement is close to an ideal case for it: the work is high volume, rule bound, and nobody enjoys doing it. Every hour absorbed is an hour a six-person finance team does not need to hire a seventh person to cover.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
Got Drive? Join AnyVan as we make moving anything, anywhere miles better and build a career that moves just as fast.


Back in 2009, our CEO Angus saw half-empty vans everywhere and knew there had to be a better way! That's how AnyVan began. He set out to create the world's most efficient logistics technology and help halve the number of wasted miles by filling those empty vans.


Since then we've become the nation's favourite way to move, with over 150k five-star reviews and 5 million customers in the UK and Europe. Our team of 400 AnyVanners across London, Cape Town and Bogota is proving that moving doesn't have to cost the earth by helping save 8,520 tonnes of Carbon each year.

Build systems that move the real world....

At AnyVan, we're building one of the most sophisticated logistics optimisation platforms in Europe. We connect customer demand with real-time driver availability, using intelligent matching, dynamic pricing, and AI to deliver a world-class service at market-beating prices.

 

By routing jobs to vans already on the road, we reduce wasted miles, cut emissions, and ensure drivers earn fairly. It's logistics, pricing, and marketplace dynamics, driven by software and increasingly by machine intelligence.


And we're moving fast.

We're embedding AI and machine learning across our core platform, not as experiments, but as production systems that drive real business outcomes:

  • Real-time, intelligent pricing that models true job-level costs and responds dynamically to supply, demand, and market conditions

  • Predictive demand and routing models that forecast driver availability and optimise job allocation before a customer even books

  • LLM-powered tooling across our internal and customer-facing products, from intelligent quoting to driver workflow automation

  • A two-sided marketplace where drivers can buy and sell jobs to maximise utilisation — powered by smart matching algorithms

This is genuinely leading-edge work: production AI systems, at scale, on problems that matter.

 

We're looking for a pragmatic engineer who enjoys solving business problems through technology to work with our Consumer teams. These squads focus on the customer journey from attraction to sign up and work closel

title: Operations Manager
description:
💰 £50,000 to £60,000 depending on experience

📍 Salary based on London. Two days a week in the office, the rest remote.

 

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $100M+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Business Operations keeps money moving correctly, keeps the platform safe, and keeps us on the right side of our banking, payment and regulatory relationships. It covers payments and payout infrastructure, treasury, verification and KYC, fraud and risk, Trust and Safety, compliance, and the data work underneath all of it. Most of that surface is currently held by a small number of very senior people. This role exists to work alongside them across all of it.

 

🎯 The Role

 

We're hiring an Operations Manager to sit at the centre of Business Operations, reporting to our Chief Business Operations Officer and working closely with our Senior Operations Manager.

This is deliberately a broad role, and we want to be straight about what that means. You will not have one fixed remit. You will be pointed at whatever the most important operational problem is that week, and expected to pick it up, work out what is actually going on, and drive it to a conclusion. Some weeks that is building out system flows. Some weeks it is a number that does not reconcile, a live incident, or a compliance pack that has to be right by end of day.

You will be taught directly by the CBOO, not handed a wiki. You will have data warehouse and provider system access from your first week. Success in month one is not output, it is that you understand how money moves through the business and have started closing things out without being chased.

You will start broad and stay broad for a while. Over time we will shape your work towards whichever areas suit you, with the intent that you eventually own one properly, with a remit and in time a team.

 

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Take on whatever is most urgent: ambiguous, half-understood problems that need the facts established and the loop closed
